Marcus, I've saved the draft to Hollis Mbeki with subject "Thornbury 2027 rate", but the $2,101 figure is not in it yet.

Hollis is not the account owner, and per-seat rates are finance figures that can only go to Anselm, June, or you. So I asked June Osei-Lark (deal desk) to approve the figure going to Hollis, and I've recorded that as a pending approval. Nothing has been sent to Hollis.

The draft has a placeholder, `[RATE PENDING APPROVAL]`, where the rate goes. Once June approves, I can add the figure, or you can add it yourself in your mailbox. I'll tell you when June replies.
